lean.statement:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [inst_2 : CompleteSpace E]
  [inst_3 : FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [inst_4 : MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] (f : E → ℝ),
  ContDiff ℝ 2 f →
    MeasureTheory.MemLp f 2 (ProbabilityTheory.stdGaussian E) →
      MeasureTheory.MemLp (gradient f) 2 (ProbabilityTheory.stdGaussian E) →
        MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun x => f x ^ 2 * Real.log (f x ^ 2)) (ProbabilityTheory.stdGaussian E) →
          have γ := ProbabilityTheory.stdGaussian E;
          ∫ (x : E), f x ^ 2 * Real.log (f x ^ 2) ∂γ - (∫ (x : E), f x ^ 2 ∂γ) * Real.log (∫ (x : E), f x ^ 2 ∂γ) ≤
            2 * ∫ (x : E), ‖gradient f x‖ ^ 2 ∂γ
approved_definition_context: stdGaussian is the standard centered Gaussian probability measure with identity covariance on a finite-dimensional real Hilbert space.
